news.title: Boy George arrives in Israel ahead of two Tel Aviv concerts
news.summary: Boy George will perform at Menora Mivtachim Arena on November 4, with special guest Ivri Lider. A second concert, on November 7, will be dedicated to the Nova community and their families.
